extracted.intended_audience: Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH biographical sketches for grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare a NIH-formatted Biographical Sketch (biosketch) for senior/key personnel and other significant contributors, following the provided headings (A–D), content requirements, and page/field limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall format and length
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the specified headings and order for each person; the entire biographical sketch must not exceed five pages per person.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name / eRA Commons user name / Position title
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME: [Full name]  eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login):  POSITION TITLE: [Current position title]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the person's full name, their eRA Commons login name (credential), and current position title exactly as instructed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training (table)
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)  INSTITUTION AND LOCATION | DEGREE (if applicable) | Completion Date MM/YYYY | FIELD OF STUDY
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List education/training beginning with baccalaureate and including postdoctoral/residency training where applicable. Provide institution and location, degree (if applicable), completion date in MM/YYYY format, and field of study. Add or delete rows as appropriate to reflect the individual's training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Personal Statement. A short statement describing the individual's scientific background, current laboratory focus, major techniques/approaches, and how the individual's experience and expertise are relevant to and will contribute to the proposed project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how the applicant's past work and current research program complement the proposed project (e.g., 'Lenette’s K08 proposal provides a unique perspective that complements and builds on my current approaches...'). Use concise narrative to demonstrate fit and qualifications; include collaborations and specific expertise where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Honors. A chronological list of positions and employment and a list of honors (awards, fellowships, recognitions) with dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide positions/employment with date ranges and institution/role, and list honors with dates. Include both academic and research appointments and relevant awards that establish qualifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contribution to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Contribution to Science. Describe major contributions to science (mechanistic summaries of research themes) with numbered subsections and supporting citations/publications for each contribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each contribution: provide a concise explanatory paragraph describing the contribution, its significance, and include key representative references (citations with authors, journal, year, PMID/PMCID where available). Use multiple numbered items to cover distinct research themes (e.g., mechanisms of genetic variation in Mtb; phenotypic variation; within-host variability; ESX1 role; translating bench science).

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support (Ongoing and Completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Research Support. List ongoing and completed research support: grant number, PI (or role), dates, funding source, project title, major goals, and the individual's role (e.g., Principal Investigator, Co-Investigator, Subcontract Principal Investigator).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate Ongoing Research Support from Completed Research Support. For each entry include dates (MM/DD/YY or MM/YYYY as provided), awarding institute (e.g., NIH/NIAID), project title, a one-sentence description of major goals, and indicate the individual's role on the award. Use consistent formatting for grant numbers and roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide complete bibliography URL (optional)
rubrics_metrics.description: URL to complete bibliography: [link to My NCBI or similar full publication list].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a link to a complete bibliography (e.g., MyBibliography/My NCBI URL) for readers to access the full list of publications beyond the selected representative citations in the Contribution to Science section.
